name: Controller restarts
note: A controller upgrade with agents mid-conversation.

steps.label: SIGTERM (upgrade to 0.47)
steps.say: A rollout on Kubernetes, or the handoff on systemd.

steps.label: link closes
steps.say: The host notices the link drop. Today this is the moment every agent PTY is killed.

steps.label: output and hooks keep flowing
steps.say: The agent doesn't notice. The host buffers output in the PTY ring and queues hook events.

steps.label: start new controller
steps.say: The new controller loads its database and opens its listener.

steps.label: reconnect, Resume{sessions, offsets}
steps.say: The host re-sends its session list and ring offsets. The controller checks epochs (I1).

steps.label: replay from offset
steps.say: The client catches up on output it missed. Nothing was lost.
